info.name: ExpressHub API
info.description: All implemented API routes. Set baseUrl (origin only), email and password in collection variables or an optional environment. See README.md for the workflow. Authentication saves tokens; shipment creation saves shipmentId; Checkout saves paymentId and checkoutUrl. Set userId and courierId explicitly before targeted operations. Stripe webhooks require genuine signed provider events. Send mutations individually. Run the Role access checks folder after logging in all three roles. Saved examples are illustrative.

request.description: CREATED→PICKED_UP→IN_TRANSIT→OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERED or FAILED. ADMIN retries FAILED→IN_TRANSIT or returns FAILED→RETURNED. Owner/ADMIN can cancel CREATED only. Operational transitions require PAID and an active assigned courier. DELIVERED also requires proof of delivery captured by the currently assigned courier (409 PROOF_REQUIRED). DELIVERED/FAILED/RETURNED require a note. Terminal states cannot transition; pending checkout blocks cancellation. Also accepts a merchant API key with the shipments:write scope (rate limited to 120 requests per minute per key); keys act with CUSTOMER rights.

item.name: Upload a CSV to preview a bulk shipment import

request.description: CUSTOMER session only; merchant API keys are rejected with 403 API_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED. Another customer's import returns 404. Checks and prices every row with the booking rules but creates nothing. Send multipart/form-data with the file, or the raw file as text/csv (optional ?fileName=). Columns are pickupContactName, pickupContactPhone, pickupAddress, deliveryContactName, deliveryContactPhone, deliveryAddress, parcelWeightKg (required) and packageDescription, parcelLengthCm, parcelWidthCm, parcelHeightCm, pickupScheduledAt (optional); headers match without regard to case, spaces or underscores, and Bangla digits are accepted in numbers and dates. Row numbers follow the spreadsheet (the header is row 1). Problems are listed per row and column with a stable code. File-level problems return 400 with errors[0].code one of empty_file, unterminated_quote, missing_columns, duplicate_column, too_many_rows, too_many_columns, cell_too_long, not_csv (params carry the details). 409 IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS while another import of yours is running; 413 above 1 MB; 429 after 5 uploads an hour. A new preview replaces your earlier unconfirmed one, and previews expire after 24 hours.

formdata.description: CSV text (UTF-8) with a header row, up to 1 MB and 500 shipments.

response.name: Success example

request.description: CUSTOMER session only; merchant API keys are rejected with 403 API_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED. Another customer's import returns 404. Returns the summary with live counts (rows created, failed and still pending), up to 200 problem rows, the first 20 valid rows with their estimated price, and up to 50 created shipments. Poll this while status is PROCESSING; a stalled import is restarted by the poll. 410 IMPORT_EXPIRED for a preview older than 24 hours.

request.description: CUSTOMER session only; merchant API keys are rejected with 403 API_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED. Another customer's import returns 404. Moves PREVIEW to PROCESSING in one conditional update, so a second confirm gets 409 IMPORT_CONFLICT. The valid rows are then created in the background in batches of 25 through the same booking code as POST /shipments (pricing, history, audit and merchant webhooks included); each row is claimed inside its own creation transaction, so a shipment is never created twice. Shipments are created unpaid, and no booking email is sent per row. 409 IMPORT_EMPTY when no row is valid; 409 IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS while another import runs; 410 IMPORT_EXPIRED after 24 hours.

request.description: CUSTOMER session, or a merchant API key with the webhooks:manage scope. The URL is resolved and every address must be public (400 WEBHOOK_URL_INVALID otherwise). The signing secret is encrypted at rest and returned once. Up to 5 endpoints (409 WEBHOOK_LIMIT). 503 WEBHOOKS_UNAVAILABLE without WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Deliveries are POSTs with ExpressHub-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>, ExpressHub-Event-Id and ExpressHub-Event-Type; any 2xx within 5 seconds counts as delivered, redirects are not followed, and failures retry with backoff for up to 8 attempts. Also accepts a merchant API key with the webhooks:manage scope (rate limited to 120 requests per minute per key); keys act with CUSTOMER rights.

request.description: Scheduler-only retry sweeper; no user token. Claims due outbox rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (safe to run concurrently), sends up to 5 batches of 20, retries failures with exponential backoff and marks rows DEAD after 5 attempts. Status changes also trigger a send right after their response. The same sweep continues confirmed CSV shipment imports that were cut short and deletes unconfirmed import previews older than 24 hours.
